dct_title_s: Bolivia (Plurinational State of) - Earthquake on Jul 03 2025
dct_description_sm: **ADAM ID: **[sm\_us7000qad7](https://api.adam.geospatial.wfp.org/api/collections/adam.adam_eq_events/items?uid=sm_us7000qad7) Magnitude 5.4 earthquake at 182.634 depth occurred on Jul 03 2025 99 km SSW of Uyuni, Bolivia. The epicentre of the earthquake was located at latitude -21.2657 longitude -67.2411. It impacted 4261 people within 50km. WFP’s Automated Disaster Analysis and Mapping (ADAM) system is an operational system for collecting, analysing and mapping geospatial and socio-economic information following sudden onset humanitarian emergencies.
